Trump Accounts just added another perk for working parents.  

Under the proposal, parents can attribute up to $2,500 per year, tax-free, directly to their child's account through their paychecks. Employers would also be able to match up to $2,500 per year, tax-free.  

The proposal will be subject to a public hearing on Oct. 15, 2026, before they are finalized.

$MCD's new Red Bull drink has brought some unexpected challenges.

Employees have taken to Reddit to share how different franchises have tried to prevent or ban workers from drinking them on shift.

Jeff Bezos just bought into Liverpool FC. ⚽ 

A consortium including Bezos and Facebook co-founder Eduardo Saverin picked up a 30% stake at a $6 billion valuation — and Bloomberg reports they eventually want full control of the club. yhoo.it/4xBIuVT
Taco Bell's former CEO is dishing out a spicy take on his longtime competitor, McDonald's.

Strategy could face MSCI index removal under a new proposal — a new methodology that would exclude "non-operating companies from its global, investable market indexes."

If these rules are adopted, @scottmelker says, other indexes could follow.

$SNDK is climbing again on Friday, extending gains from a 12% rise in the prior session. 

Wall Street was overwhelmingly bullish on the company's long-term growth targets for 2028 through 2030, announced at the company's investor day.

President Trump is being sued for his decision to charge institutions $100,000 per month for advanced access to Truth Social posts.

The suit was filed by The Intercept Media, a news organization, and by the Freedom of the Press Foundation, a non-profit group.

$RDDT stock surges nearly 16% on Friday after announcing it will be part of the S&P 500 starting August 18. 👀📈

"Now that they're a big part of the S&P 500, well, they're going to be in a lot of index funds all of a sudden. So like it or not, you're going to own it," Investopedia's @calebsilver says.
